name: Reporter
logline_subject_info: An energetic middle-aged female reporter for 'CN NEWS' covering the 'wedding of the century'.
visual_desc: A photorealistic portrait of an energetic woman in her late 40s with sharp, intelligent features and Eastern European ethnicity. She has shoulder-length brown hair, styled professionally, and wears thin-framed rectangular glasses. Her expression is engaged and focused. She is dressed for a cool day in a stylish, well-fitted grey wool coat over a dark turtleneck. A scarf with a subtle, repeating 'CN NEWS' logo pattern is wrapped around her neck. Her skin has realistic texture, with fine lines around her eyes. The background is a solid deep-charcoal. Soft studio lighting with a faint warm side-light. Wears glasses, a gray coat, and a scarf with logos.
video_visual_desc: Energetic woman, late 40s, Eastern European, brown hair, wearing rectangular glasses, a grey wool coat, and a 'CN NEWS' logo scarf.
behavioral_signature: Under pressure: becomes more performative and professional, focusing intensely on her reporting duties to control the narrative. Power move: uses her microphone as a tool of authority, directing attention and framing the event. Tell: pushes her glasses up her nose when a situation becomes unpredictable.
physical_vocabulary: Leans forward into her subject or camera, occupying space with professional confidence. Uses sharp, deliberate gestures with the hand holding the microphone. Her posture is upright and alert, constantly scanning the environment for new angles.
